About this tool

Enter your height and weight to calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and see which standard category it falls under. Works in centimetres/kilograms or feet-inches/pounds.

Frequently asked questions

What is the BMI formula?

BMI = weight in kilograms ÷ (height in metres × height in metres).

Is BMI accurate for everyone?

BMI is a general screening measure and doesn't account for muscle mass, age, or body composition. It's a useful starting point, not a full medical diagnosis — check with a doctor for personalised advice.
